scenario.description: A battalion executive officer must publish next week's routine sustainment-training board, setting the driver-certification block, a radio-procedures refresher, the total assigned training vehicles, the number currently released, and the required administrative controls.

shared_context.S1: The battalion must publish next week's sustainment-training board by 1600 today.
shared_context.S2: The board includes a driver-certification block and a radio-procedures refresher for support personnel.
shared_context.S3: The training yard is available Monday through Friday, and the routine driver-certification block is normally scheduled on Tuesday morning.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Patel signs the final board, and the battalion's weekly training huddle is the routine point at which the S-3 and motor pool chief report schedule changes, readiness changes, and required administrative controls before publication.
shared_context.S5: The standard driver-certification block uses all six assigned training trucks when they are released and available.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward; the tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide.

PF2.text: SFC Alvarez confirmed during this morning's inspection that only four of the six assigned training trucks currently have completed brake inspections; the other two will not be released until Friday at 0800, and the inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. The two trucks must remain on hold until their inspections are complete.

acceptance_conditions: The driver-certification decision must either keep the block on Tuesday with four trucks while acknowledging the two-truck shortfall and Friday 0800 release, or move it to Friday after 0800.
The radio-procedures refresher must be scheduled for Wednesday from 1300 to 1500.
Exactly six vehicles must be recorded as the total assigned vehicle count for the full driver-certification block.
Exactly four vehicles are currently released for training, with the other two remaining on hold until Friday at 0800.
A commitment must record submission of an attendance roster for the radio refresher.
Exactly two unreleased training trucks must be recorded as on hold.
The higher-headquarters radio tasking must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: ('Friday' in decisions['driver_certification_window'] and '0800' in decisions['driver_certification_window']) or ('Tuesday' in decisions['driver_certification_window'] and ('four' in decisions['driver_certification_window'] or '4' in decisions['driver_certification_window']) and ('Friday' in decisions['driver_certification_window'] or '0800' in decisions['driver_certification_window']))
content_checks.C5: any('attendance roster' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The higher-headquarters tasking changes the radio refresher to the exact Wednesday 1300-1500 window and requires an attendance roster submission commitment.

The inspection status changes the driver-certification plan to acknowledge four currently released trucks and two held until Friday 0800, while preserving the total assigned count of six and the exact hold count of two.
